[SWS_DM_00814] Providing the
PowerMode
in
DoIP
protocol messages
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_00026, RS_Diag_00080
⌈
If the DM needs to know the
PowerMode
to be able to react or answer on any DoIP
message, it shall obtain it, by calling the method
ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode::
GetDoIPPowerMode
.
⌋
